headline_seed: Japan earthquake searches continue into night, with people missing in mall and collapsed factory - BBC
draft_text:
#BreakingMews A 7.1-magnitude quake struck Kumamoto, Japan at 4:27 p.m. Tuesday. A mall explosion left 20-30 employees unaccounted for, per NHK via NBC News. AP confirms tsunami advisory lifted. At least 50 injured.

And that's the mews.
